title: AppBot Shared Reflection
desc: Shared AppBot reflection skill for recurring machine fixes, cross-intelligence lessons, and durable knowledge promotion.
steps: Trigger this skill only for lessons that genuinely apply across multiple families, such as hook routing, binary health checks, encoding boundaries, or shared guard behavior.
Capture four facts: symptom, root cause class, fix, and proof. Keep the note short, factual, and reusable.
Keep the rule model-neutral and family-neutral. Do not mention a single model as the owner unless the lesson truly affects all families.
Prefer the shared skill for cross-family invariants only. Put family-specific workarounds in the family skill instead.
If the lesson can be expressed as a generic prevention rule, write that rule. If it depends on one model's quirks, do not put it here.
2026-06-14 lesson: route selection and health checks must be validated from the real executable path and the active family, not from a shared guess about identity.
2026-06-14 lesson: an exit 1 from a hook usually means a guard chain. Separate the failing layer before labeling the whole harness broken.

requirements.expect: records direct codex.exe smoke tests and wkagent-name identity checks
keeps guard-chain lessons model-specific instead of shared by accident
